verdict.rationale: The phone quickstart shows code calling a `vapi` client object (`await vapi.assistant`), which points to an official server-side SDK. The web quickstart covers building voice interfaces for web and mobile, suggesting client SDKs, but no page explicitly lists the official SDKs, their languages, or their packages. The CLI and MCP server are separate surfaces and are not counted here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and supported languages, package and install details, SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
